stepcap.def: STEP-CAP(t, a): R acc at the value slot of V_t on items whose R(V_{t-1}) decodes E_{t-1} exactly; a = non-VOID content slots of E_{t-1}; t <= n; slope over a with >= 3 t values (cells with >= 10 items)

bank_ablate.def: draft §7 / note 211-14: versions 1..t-2 masked at every pass (core, gather) and in the coda; V_0 and the newest kept; K' = n + 2

bank_off.def: every bank logit -inf (core and coda; the gather still reads all versions), K' = n + 2

probe_protocol: fresh blocks 10-11 + coda bank beta / gamma copy (ln_f, wte frozen); 2k steps, bs 64, AdamW 1e-4 wd 0.01; pool 20k n 3..8 (rng 21130, test + SERIAL pool excluded); batch draws rng 21131; model frozen; fp32

vswap.def: note 211-4 class A (top level, decisive): t uniform over 2..n-1 with two original-leaf operands (rng 21120), donor = those leaves resampled; class B (vswap.class_B, descriptive): handles with >= 1 computed operand, donor = every leaf under the handle resampled; value and y change; clean = recipient and donor correct at K' = n + 2; follow = y_donor, own = y; (iv) V_0 masked for passes > t (the coda never reads V_0)

class_B.def: note 211-4 class A (top level, decisive): t uniform over 2..n-1 with two original-leaf operands (rng 21120), donor = those leaves resampled; class B (vswap.class_B, descriptive): handles with >= 1 computed operand, donor = every leaf under the handle resampled; value and y change; clean = recipient and donor correct at K' = n + 2; follow = y_donor, own = y; (iv) V_0 masked for passes > t (the coda never reads V_0)

stall.def: stored V_t := V_{t-1} at t = ceil(n/2); stalled acc at K' = n + 1 / intact acc at K' = n, pooled n 4..8
